items: Dual project creation (Map or Image): Geographic projects (online basemaps, address search, GPS) and Image projects (import scans/plans PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, BMP up to 25 MB).
Custom image calibration: By two points (real distance in km and optionally paper cm) or known ratio (meters per pixel), with pixel-precision tool (arrows + Shift).
Map projection choice: Mercator (straight lines and bearings matching online portals) or Geodesic WGS84 (shortest paths on curved Earth).
Save, Import/Export: Automatic local storage, JSON format, and GPX track export.
Action history (Undo / Redo): Manage up to 1,000 steps (drawings, notes, groups, visibility, projections) with Ctrl/Cmd+Z and Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+Z / Ctrl+Y shortcuts.
Multiple basemap selector (geographic projects): Geoportail (IGN), OpenStreetMap, Google Plan, Google Satellite, and Google Relief.
Global visibility management: Hide/show basemap (clean white background) or filter by category.
Precision Mode (Magnifier): Toggle with Z key to show a circular magnifying lens (2.5x) with center crosshair.
Navigation Mode along shapes: Step-by-step tour of a circle or line using arrow keys (← →) with dynamic speed.
Points: Created via direct click, right-click, or coordinates, with automatic reverse geocoding.
Circles: Defined by center and radius (in km or cm depending on paper equivalence).

Lines & Routes: Two-points line (with panel drag-and-drop), Azimuth Line, Line at Angle from reference, dynamic Intersection Line, Parallel Line, and Free Hand Mode (Alt/Ctrl locking). IGN road/walking routes with stops.
Polygons: Created from at least 3 points, perimeter display, and center extraction.
Address & place search: Integrated general bar to center the map.
Search along a path ("Search nearby"): Distance band (0.5 to 25 km) with advanced filters by name, category, and altitude, including elevation data.
Ruler tool (instant): Quick measurement of distances and bearings without cluttering layers.
Bearings Analysis: Complete matrix of distances and angles between points with sorting and direct navigation.
Layers Panel: Categorized sorting, text filters, and custom groups (drag-and-drop folders).
Contextual and standalone notes: Attached to geometric elements (hover tooltips) or free.
Integrated PDF document reader: Up to 50 MB, with zoom, rotation, thumbnails, page fit, and local secure password management.
Visual customization: Choice of 14 graphic theme palettes (Cyberpunk, Gold & Velvet, etc.).
Multilingual: Interface fully available in French and English.
Comprehensive keyboard shortcuts for navigation, undo, precision mode, and geometric constraints.
